title: About this template
paragraphs: This is the BrowserUX Starter Vite + React, a production-ready single-page application built with React 19, React Router v7, and Vite as the build tool.

It comes fully configured for deployment: PWA support, a custom service worker with Workbox, offline fallback, optimized builds, and SEO basics out of the box. The codebase is structured and commented to be maintainable and easy to extend, making it a solid starting point for real projects.

main.jsx is the entry point of the app, wiring together the router and the root render. RootLayout.jsx handles persistent UI (nav, transitions), while each page component fetches its own data from a static JSON file via a route loader before rendering.
features: ⚡ Vite for ultra-fast development and optimized builds
📁 Clean SPA structure with root layout, pages, navigation, and 404 handling
🧠 Custom service worker with Workbox and offline fallback
🧰 Built-in scripts: image optimization, sitemap generation, dynamic precache
🚦 Global loading component for route transitions (NavigateLoader.jsx)
📤 <browserux-share-button>: native Web Share API Web Component
🔄 <browserux-pwa-ui>: install prompt and update notification Web Component
🌙 Dark mode ready with alternate favicons and CSS variables
